name: Acid fuzz bass
desc: Big beat acid bass in F# minor: a sawtooth riff squelching through a high-resonance filter sweep with heavy shape fuzz — the Block Rockin' Beats lineage where a 303 line gets mastered like a rock record. Peak doubles to sixteenths with octave stabs.

code.full: note("<[f#1 ~ f#1 f#1 ~ a1 ~ e1] [f#1 ~ f#1 f#1 ~ a1 b1 ~] [f#1 ~ f#1 f#1 ~ a1 ~ e1] [c#2 ~ b1 a1 ~ e1 f#1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.004).decay(.22).sustain(.28).release(.08).shape(.55).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).lpq(9).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[f#1 f#2 f#1 f#1 f#2 a1 a2 e1] [f#1 f#2 f#1 f#1 ~ a1 b1 b2] [f#1 f#2 f#1 f#1 f#2 a1 a2 e1] [c#2 c#1 b1 b2 a1 a2 e1 f#1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(.25).release(.07).shape(.6).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).lpq(10).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
